places.name: Black Kettle National Grassland (Lake Marvin, Texas unit)
places.agency: USDA Forest Service (administered by Cibola National Forest and National Grasslands)
places.coord_point: Lake Marvin Campground (best-known campground, Texas unit)
nearby: Black Kettle and Skipout Campgrounds (same grassland, locations not verified)
places.blurb: Texas unit of a Panhandle grassland, with a 12-site lakeside campground near Canadian.
places.status_note: No Lake Marvin closure stated; a search snippet mentioned Stage II fire restrictions for Lake Marvin with no date. Confirm with the Black Kettle office in Cheyenne, OK.
places.notes: This unit is administered by Cibola National Forest and National Grasslands (Albuquerque). It is not in the East Texas National Forests and Grasslands in Texas home page, which does not list it. The Wikipedia infobox point 35.6166,-99.68655 is in Roger Mills County, Oklahoma (Cheyenne area), so it fails the county check and was rejected. Official point is Lake Marvin Campground (printed 35.8858655,-100.18032333): 12 units, single electric sites at $20/night, tent camping no fee, first come first served; the page says 12 miles east of Canadian on US 60. Texas portion is 576 acres of the 31,300-acre grassland, per the official Black Kettle page. Hemphill County is from the Wikipedia infobox; the official page does not name the county. Dispersed camping exists on the grassland but is not confirmed for the Texas unit, so camping_kinds lists tent only. dark_sky null: not on DarkSky search results (not exhaustive).
